stories.title: NFL preseason Week 1 takeaways: Ja'Kobi Lane scores touchdown to continue banner preseason
stories.summary: The NFL preseason is underway! How did rookies and players in new places perform in their debuts?

stories.title: 2026 HOF class honors women's hoops, NBA icons
stories.summary: Candace Parker and Elena Delle Donne headlined a 2026 Hall of Fame class that honored women's hoops, as well as NBA luminaries such as Doc Rivers, Mike D'Antoni and Amar'e Stoudemire.

stories.title: Baez hits 3 straight HRs in 'crazy,' historic debut
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie outfielder Joshua Baez set an MLB record with three home runs in the first three plate appearances of his major league career Saturday.

stories.title: Messi has 3rd straight penalty miss in Miami loss
stories.summary: Lionel Messi missed his third penalty in a row as Inter Miami suffered a third consecutive loss in a 4-1 rout at first-place Nashville SC on Saturday.

stories.title: Monken thrilled with Watson's 'awesome' 1st half
stories.summary: Quarterback Deshaun Watson, in his first game since the 2024 season, completed 11 of 15 passes for 126 yards and led two scoring drives, the only points for the Cleveland Browns in a 34-10 preseason loss to the Chicago Bears on Saturday at Soldier Field.
